The intended audience of the text is **busy families and home cooks**.

The text shifts from a simple riddle ("Name the animal that says 'meow'") to a detailed product description of a kitchen blender. The language used in the second part—highlighting features like "easy-to-clean design," "powerful motor," and suitability for "smooth purees to chunky salsas"—is marketing copy aimed at consumers interested in cooking and kitchen appliances. The mention of "busy families" specifically targets parents or household managers looking for convenient, versatile kitchen tools.
